title: Proser
summary: PRO'SER, noun s as z. [from prose.] A writer of prose. 1. In cant language, one who makes a tedious narration of uninteresting matters.

inlines.v: PRO'SER, noun s as z. [from prose.] A writer of prose. 1. In cant language, one who makes a tedious narration of uninteresting matters.
